posts.title: Video Game Review: Black Myth: Wukong
posts.description: Video Game Review: 9/10 What I'll remember most about this game is that I couldn't get enough of exploring. I grinded out every chapter of this game, but it did not feel like a grind at all. I had a blast exploring every nook and cranny, and I felt like I was rewarded for it. posts.title: Movie Review: Memento
posts.description: Movie Review: 8.25/10 Slow burn but does a great job of drawing you in. Once the basic facts/rules are established in the first half of the movie, the second half is extremely enjoyable. Held back slightly by the execution but the idea is awesome
